elements_selected.content: Create crates/spindle-core/src/term.rs with Term enum: Symbol(SymbolId), Integer(i64), Decimal(rust_decimal::Decimal), Float(f64). Implement Display, Clone, Debug. For Float variant, implement a canonicalized finite-float wrapper (or OrderedFloat equivalent) that normalizes -0.0 to 0.0 and rejects NaN/Inf, with stable Eq+Hash. Add Term::is_numeric(), Term::numeric_eq() with cross-type promotion (REQ-005). Add NumericValue enum (Integer/Decimal/Float) for arithmetic expression evaluation results that converts to/from Term.
